<The number behind the whole category>

Why this role exists

0
Pilots Failed

MIT: enterprise GenAI pilots delivering no measurable business impact

The cause was deployment, not the models

  • ▸Models got good. Making them work inside a real enterprise did not.
  • ▸The hard part is everything around the model - security & compliance, data quality, integration, governance, change management.

The value and the hiring moved to the person who closes that gap in the field.

MIT NANDA

Who can become an FDE?

<The FDE Story>

How it all started.

The role wasn't created. It evolved to solve real-world problems.

A journey from the battlefield to the boardroom
1950s - Today
Military Origin
“Forward deployed” meant being closest to the mission - where decisions had to be made.
2008 - 2016
Palantir Era
Palantir popularised the “Forward Deployed Engineer” role by embedding engineers alongside defence, intelligence and government customers to solve mission-critical problems.
2020 - 2025
Enterprise AI Revolution
LLMs became powerful. But enterprises still struggled to deploy, integrate and scale AI in production.
2026 and Beyond
Forward Deployed AI Engineer
Engineers who build AI, deploy it, and drive customer outcomes.
It sits at the intersection of three critical worlds
Where AI, Systems, and People meet to create IMPACT
★Most tech folks have one or two. The FDE has all three - that is the whole scarcity.

FDE Roles and Career Opportunities (India)

Who does what, who they report to, and how many customers each person handles.

★
Director / practice head
Manager · 15+ yrs
Answerable for delivery across every customer. Owns hiring and budget.
CustomersAll of them
the two ways up from Senior FDE
IC track
◆
Staff / principal FDE
10-15 yrs · nobody reports to you
Builds the reusable pieces so projects do not start from scratch.
CustomersAll, none full time
Manager / Leadership track
■
FDE manager
8-12 yrs · 6-10 people report to you
Decides who goes to which customer. Steps in when things go wrong.
CustomersSeveral, via team
⚑
FDE lead
5-8 yrs · first leadership step
Runs the plan for one project and keeps the customer updated.
Customers1 customer, 1 project
●
Senior FDE - the path splits here
IC · 4-6 yrs · stay hands-on, or start leading
You are the customer's main point of contact. You decide how it gets built.
Customers1 or 2
●
Mid FDE
IC · 2-4 yrs
Owns one part of the project - say all the data work - end to end.
CustomersJust 1
●
Associate FDE
IC · 0-2 yrs
Writes code for one customer. A senior FDE checks it before it ships.
CustomersJust 1
Based on 650+ FDE job postings across India - experience bands and responsibilities are indicative.
Organisation structures, titles and reporting lines vary across companies.
Smaller projects may need one FDE, while larger engagements typically involve multiple FDEs and cross-functional teams.
